metadata.title: Silver Foil Seal on Leather Texture

retrievalProfile.description: A centered silver metallic circular seal with a monogram and perimeter text, set against a high-contrast black pebbled leather background.
triggerTerms: silver foil seal on black leather
metallic monogram emblem on pebbled texture

recipe.visualDefinition: A square composition featuring a centered, circular silver emblem. The emblem consists of a central monogram surrounded by two concentric rings; the inner ring contains circular-path text, and the outer ring is a decorative beaded or serrated border. The entire graphic is rendered with a metallic silver foil effect, showing slight texture and reflection, placed on a dark, matte, pebbled leather surface.
coreVisualRelationships: Centered circular emblem against a square textured field
High contrast between metallic silver and deep black leather
Concentric hierarchy from central monogram to outer decorative border
Tactile relationship between the smooth foil and the rough leather grain

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The seal is perfectly centered, occupying approximately 40% of the total frame width.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central monogram within the inner circle.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Radial movement starting from the center monogram, moving outward to the circular text, and finally to the decorative border.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the black leather, emphasizing the central metallic element.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays (leather highlights and foil shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the dark background and bright metallic foreground.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Bold slab serif and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Monogram uses mirrored or interlocking letterforms
Perimeter text follows a perfect circular path
High stroke weight for legibility against texture
characterSpecificRedesigns: Mirrored 'R' or 'B' elements in the central monogram to create symmetry
Wide tracking for perimeter text to fill the circular arc
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavy, stylized monogram paired with a clean, legible geometric sans-serif for the circular text.

candidateDirections.reason: Strong slab-serif presence for the monogram
Geometric clarity for the circular path text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-resolution, top-down macro shot of black pebbled leather texture. The lighting should be even with very subtle highlights to show the grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a circular silver foil emblem to the center. The emblem should include a mirrored monogram in the center, a ring of uppercase text following a circular path, and an outer decorative beaded border. The silver should have a metallic sheen and appear slightly embossed into the leather.

verificationChecks: Is the leather texture visible and realistic?
Is the silver foil centered and circular?
Is the text following a perfect arc?
Is the contrast high enough for legibility?

avoid: Flat gray instead of metallic silver

postGenerationChecks: Check for metallic sheen in the silver areas
Verify the leather grain is consistent across the frame
Ensure the monogram is legible and centered
Confirm the circular text is properly oriented
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply a [Metallic Color] [Shape] emblem with [Monogram Style] and [Text Path] onto a [Material Texture] background.
